description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values as a function of layer number. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and extends from -1 to 21 with a tick label interval of 5. The scale is linear. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and extends from 0.0 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The scale is linear. A blue, dashed line labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03” begins at approximately 0.28 at x = -1 and decreases to approximately -0.05 at x = 21. An orange, dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44” begins at approximately 0.92 at x = -1 and decreases to approximately 0.16 at x = 21, with fluctuations between approximately 0.2 and 0.4 from x = 16 to x = 21. A green, dashed-hyphen line labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33” begins at approximately 0.88 at x = -1 and decreases to approximately 0.08 at x = 21.
